editorial.blurb: Tortas Frontera brings authentic, craveable Mexican tortas and quesadillas to ORD with fresh ingredients and vibrant salsa that justify the airport premium.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the queso birria torta and dip the bread into the rich broth with onions and salsa—arrive hungry and don't skip the salsa, which reviewers rave about as a game-changer.

topDishes.note: Juicy, rich, and bold with the signature dipping experience
Perfectly grilled with tender chicken and melty cheese
